description: Query any DNS record type for a domain: MX, TXT, A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, SOA, CAA, or "ALL" for every record type at the name plus its DMARC record in one call. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

type.description: Record type, e.g. "MX", "TXT", "A", or "ALL" for every type at once. Defaults to MX if omitted.

name: check_dns

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.

title: DNS records
